findings.body: The callbacks target the nonexistent alias alias, so the providers created by the loop remain in the test realm and can pollute subsequent tests or cause alias/count-dependent failures.
findings.failure_mode: The test suite loses isolation because setup data is not removed after the test.
findings.impact: The callbacks target the nonexistent alias alias, so the providers created by the loop remain in the test realm and can pollute subsequent tests or cause alias/count-dependent failures.
findings.root_cause: The cleanup resource is hard-coded to a different alias than the one assigned to each created identity provider.
findings.suggested_fix: Register cleanup against the created alias, for example testRealm().identityProviders().get("idp-alias-" + i)::remove.
findings.title: Test cleanup removes the wrong identity-provider alias
findings.trigger: Run the test and execute its registered cleanup callbacks after creating providers named idp-alias-0 through idp-alias-19.
findings.verifier_reason: Line 381 verbatim shows getCleanup().addCleanup(testRealm().identityProviders().get("alias")::remove) while the loop creates providers with alias "idp-alias-" + i. The literal string "alias" does not match any created provider, so cleanup will fail to remove the 20 created providers.

pr.title: Add cache for IdentityProviderStorageProvider.getForLogin

raw_findings.body: The returned stream contains an organization-aware IdentityProviderModel whose isEnabled() is false, violating getForLogin's contract that results are suitable for login and allowing callers to display or use a disabled provider.
raw_findings.failure_mode: Login-provider results become stale when organization state changes without changing the cached IDP membership set.
raw_findings.impact: The returned stream contains an organization-aware IdentityProviderModel whose isEnabled() is false, violating getForLogin's contract that results are suitable for login and allowing callers to display or use a disabled provider.
raw_findings.root_cause: The new cached implementation treats cached internal IDs as sufficient and does not revalidate the effective login predicate after resolving each provider, even though resolution can wrap the provider with organization-dependent enabled state.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Reapply getLoginPredicate() to the organization-aware models before adding them to the cached result, and apply the same predicate to both delegate fallback return paths.
raw_findings.title: Cached login results can include identity providers that are no longer enabled
raw_findings.trigger: Populate a login cache with a public identity provider linked to an organization, disable that organization, and then call getForLogin again through the cached path from a caller that does not apply the FreeMarker bean's additional isEnabled filter.

raw_findings.body: All organization-specific result sets accumulate in the single IdentityProviderListQuery for the mode; the cache value and its serialized copies grow with the number of organizations, increasing memory use, cache transfer cost, and lookup latency until invalidation or expiry.
raw_findings.failure_mode: High-cardinality organization traffic turns a normal login lookup cache into a growing realm-wide data structure.
raw_findings.impact: All organization-specific result sets accumulate in the single IdentityProviderListQuery for the mode; the cache value and its serialized copies grow with the number of organizations, increasing memory use, cache transfer cost, and lookup latency until invalidation or expiry.
raw_findings.root_cause: The cache key contains only the fetch mode while organizationId is stored as an additional unbounded search key inside one query object.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Include organizationId in the cache key so entries are independently bounded/evicted, or introduce an explicit bounded policy for the searchKeys map instead of accumulating every organization query in one cache object.
raw_findings.title: Login cache retains an unbounded entry for every organization queried
raw_findings.trigger: In a realm with many organizations, repeatedly call getForLogin with ORG_ONLY or ALL and a different organizationId for each request while identity-provider data remains otherwise unchanged.

raw_findings.impact: The callback attempts to remove alias instead of idp-alias-20, leaving that provider in the test realm and potentially affecting later tests.

raw_findings.suggested_fix: Register cleanup with testRealm().identityProviders().get("idp-alias-20")::remove, or retain the created alias in a variable and use it for cleanup.

finding.body: The returned stream contains an organization-aware IdentityProviderModel whose isEnabled() is false, violating getForLogin's contract that results are suitable for login and allowing callers to display or use a disabled provider.
finding.failure_mode: Login-provider results become stale when organization state changes without changing the cached IDP membership set.
finding.impact: The returned stream contains an organization-aware IdentityProviderModel whose isEnabled() is false, violating getForLogin's contract that results are suitable for login and allowing callers to display or use a disabled provider.
finding.root_cause: The new cached implementation treats cached internal IDs as sufficient and does not revalidate the effective login predicate after resolving each provider, even though resolution can wrap the provider with organization-dependent enabled state.
finding.suggested_fix: Reapply getLoginPredicate() to the organization-aware models before adding them to the cached result, and apply the same predicate to both delegate fallback return paths.
finding.title: Cached login results can include identity providers that are no longer enabled
finding.trigger: Populate a login cache with a public identity provider linked to an organization, disable that organization, and then call getForLogin again through the cached path from a caller that does not apply the FreeMarker bean's additional isEnabled filter.
finding.verifier_reason: The patch at line 246 calls session.identityProviders().getById(id) which returns an organization-aware model via createOrganizationAwareIdentityProviderModel (see line 141). The callers in OrganizationAwareIdentityProviderBean (lines 75, 80) explicitly re-check isEnabled() after getForLogin returns. The claim that disabled providers violate the contract is ungrounded since the FreeMarker bean applies the filter.

The callers in OrganizationAwareIdentityProviderBean (lines 75, 80) explicitly re-check isEnabled() after getForLogin returns. The claim that disabled providers violate the contract is ungrounded since the FreeMarker bean applies the filter.

finding.body: All organization-specific result sets accumulate in the single IdentityProviderListQuery for the mode; the cache value and its serialized copies grow with the number of organizations, increasing memory use, cache transfer cost, and lookup latency until invalidation or expiry.
finding.failure_mode: High-cardinality organization traffic turns a normal login lookup cache into a growing realm-wide data structure.
finding.impact: All organization-specific result sets accumulate in the single IdentityProviderListQuery for the mode; the cache value and its serialized copies grow with the number of organizations, increasing memory use, cache transfer cost, and lookup latency until invalidation or expiry.
finding.root_cause: The cache key contains only the fetch mode while organizationId is stored as an additional unbounded search key inside one query object.
finding.suggested_fix: Include organizationId in the cache key so entries are independently bounded/evicted, or introduce an explicit bounded policy for the searchKeys map instead of accumulating every organization query in one cache object.
finding.title: Login cache retains an unbounded entry for every organization queried
finding.trigger: In a realm with many organizations, repeatedly call getForLogin with ORG_ONLY or ALL and a different organizationId for each request while identity-provider data remains otherwise unchanged.
finding.verifier_reason: The claim that all organization-specific results accumulate unboundedly in one cache entry is speculative. The IdentityProviderListQuery stores searchKeys as a Map, but the patch shows cache invalidation occurs on IDP changes (registerIDPLoginInvalidation). Without evidence of actual unbounded growth or missing eviction, the performance impact is not proven from the patch.

rejected_findings.reason: The claim that all organization-specific results accumulate unboundedly in one cache entry is speculative. The IdentityProviderListQuery stores searchKeys as a Map, but the patch shows cache invalidation occurs on IDP changes (registerIDPLoginInvalidation). Without evidence of actual unbounded growth or missing eviction, the performance impact is not proven from the patch.
